name: Chief mount groom
design: Broad stocky mature male Yautja with deep olive and ochre mottling, low broad posterior cranium, heavy orbital ridges, four short stout separate mandibles around an inner mouth; thick black scalp tendrils tied low with plain iron rings. Sleeveless weathered chestnut leather work vest over dark linen, broad divided knee apron, padded forearms and calf wraps. Carries a large stiff rectangular grooming brush in right hand and a compact brass pot of hide balm in left. Rounded barrel torso and solid relaxed stance, unmasked. NO combat armor.
